done_when: The guide and the constitution defaults page mark the defaults as built in for an app with libs/organisations or apps/api/app/organisations, so a Python starter app is asked nothing about them
why: The guide marks the constitution's defaults as built in only when the app has libs/organisations, the TypeScript starter's folder, so a Python app from forge init --starter python (which keeps it in apps/api/app/organisations) gets asked about defaults its starter already builds
